scope: Only local synthetic data; Reader Web browser uses webpack development server; separate optimized production build. No CI or production claim. Receipt times are filesystem completion times in Asia/Shanghai.

lab_extension.origin: scope lab loopback only; not a production installable

steps: installed extension, toolbar registered to open side panel
signed-out native authorization and delayed anonymous read did not erase the new login
genuine browser PKCE consent and explicit destination
real recent and project-pinned rows; long localized titles, both themes and 200% CSS magnification without overflow
real capture, ZIP and committed file import
same-document navigation and a changed message invalidate the previous check without recapturing
committed page button opens without capturing and revisiting distinguishes a historical save
identical import returns same conversation
suffix appended to same conversation
branch conflict requests review
browser IME composition and keyboard search focus (not a physical input-method test)
metadata result opens Reader in a new tab without a device credential in the URL
catalog boot retries the failed read without a new grant; empty search keeps the query, project and pin scope; magnified rows yield space to titles
move, scoped conversation search and project pin persisted
separate outcome retains original binding; unchanged receipt reports actual moved project
file hit returns only its conversation; opened Reader file panel and renamed owned file there
panel and same Reader document: verified both ZIP policies, attachment ownership, own private notes and exclusion of another subject
removed preset: both quick actions returned 409 rather than downloading a previous package

only selected source messages and image bytes reached Reader; independent owner session changed the tail, retained choices required a second explicit click; fixed-target web append preserved originals
source closed mid-resource: no upload, actionable interruption
real OPFS quota override: insufficient temporary space produced no upload
over-limit synthetic source stopped before upload with a distinct recovery state
disconnected resource requires review before any publication
acknowledged partial save remains partial in the durable receipt, panel and page button
terminated browser, opened same disposable profile in a different browser process: original accepted receipt persisted
durable received job finished after source closed, panel reloaded and worker restarted
offscreen fault injection dropped a real 201; recovered the same conversation via request receipt
browser opened a native SIDE_PANEL context through a trusted gesture
